credits: Sophos builds on Prime Intellect's open-source Prime Agent (PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent, MIT). Ergon, Fleet, OpenRO and OpenBell ship as cross-platform single-binary Rust desktop and web apps (Linux, macOS, Windows) on one shared House Frontend design system.
intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. Four cross-platform single-binary Rust desktop and web applications (Linux, macOS, and Windows .exe with chromeless desktop launch) make up my current releases: Ergon v0.7.0 (personal employee agent desk with background cadence scheduler, .history/ file version diff & restore, tamper-evident Field-Book audit bundles, 3-company switcher, and 12 workflows), Fleet v0.8.0 (parallel coding-agent mission control with interactive multi-wave Board / DAG Graph toggle, confirmation-gated PR Preview, Worktree Inspector, Daily Dispatch Budget guardrails, and Auto-Heal), OpenRO v0.10.0 (RoPilot-grade 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with Agent/Plan/Ask modes and reviewable unified Luau diffs, directly embedded live Roblox Studio + auto-synced Explorer, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, 8-pack Tool Library, Market Taste Craft Radar, Blender/WAV tools, and Rojo .zip export), and OpenBell v0.8.0 (live-connected Kalshi Trade API v2 trading and quant desk behind fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine).
